content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

Show me the count of support tickets for each service type, specifically for Cellular and Business Internet services

content.statement:
WITH __support_tickets AS (
  SELECT
    ticket_id,
    service_type
  FROM cortex_demo.cortex_sample_data.support_tickets
)
SELECT
  service_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ticket_id) AS ticket_count
FROM __support_tickets
WHERE
  service_type IN ('Cellular', 'Business Internet')
GROUP BY
  service_type
 -- Generated by Cortex Analyst
;

content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

Which service type has the highest number of unique support tickets?

content.statement:
WITH __support_tickets AS (
  SELECT
    ticket_id,
    service_type
  FROM cortex_demo.cortex_sample_data.support_tickets
)
SELECT
  service_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ticket_id) AS ticket_count
FROM __support_tickets
GROUP BY
  service_type
ORDER BY
  ticket_count DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1
 -- Generated by Cortex Analyst
;
